Samuel, this is Karl Ellsworth, I am general counsel at Brightmoor Capital. We are the foreign landlord on the Pinheiros lease and we go to signing in eleven days. I want to be very clear about what I expect before then. We are having the title searched by our own firm in Sao Paulo, and we have already had the property appraised. What I need from your side is the due diligence report, confirmation that the lien on the parking structure has been discharged, and a counsel opinion letter on signing authority. I would also like to have the novation agreement reviewed before it goes into escrow, because the tenant assigned the original lease last year and I am not comfortable with the assignment language. Send me a timeline today, please, with who is doing what.

Samuel, Diane. I read your draft reply to Karl and there is one thing to fix before you send it. You wrote that you will review the novation agreement, you will search the title, you will discharge the lien. All in the first person, all yourself. That is not how a senior lawyer answers a general counsel, and it is not even true. Say what you will have done, and by whom. We will have the novation agreement reviewed by our banking team. We are having the lien discharge confirmed by the registry this week. The structure does two things for you. It shows you are coordinating a transaction rather than doing tasks, and it protects you, because you are not personally promising work that another team delivers. Same facts, different register.
